description: This Java class 'SearchSourceBuilder' provides a builder pattern implementation for constructing 'SearchSource' objects used in search operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages configurations such as filters, sort options, namespaces, fields, headers, and timeouts for search queries, ensuring proper validation and conversion of input parameters. The class incorporates parsing of RQL expressions, handling of sorting options, and integration with Ditto's data models to facilitate customizable search source creation.

classes.name: SearchSourceBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of SearchSource with customizable search parameters, including fields, filters, sorting, timeouts, and headers, ensuring validation and proper conversion of inputs.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a SearchSource object based on the configured parameters, generating a StreamThings object with current filter, namespace, and sort configurations.

methods.name: pubSubMediator
methods.description: Sets the pub-sub mediator actor reference used for error reporting, returning the builder for chaining.

methods.name: conciergeForwarder
methods.description: Sets the actor reference for the concierge forwarder, used to send commands, enabling builder chaining.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Sets the fields to include in search results either via a JsonFieldSelector or a comma-separated string.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Assigns the filter string for the search query after validation of the RQL syntax.

methods.name: namespaces
methods.description: Configures the list of namespace strings from a JsonArray or comma-separated string.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Defines the sort order as a string, utilizing default if null or empty.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Configures the sort options and fields from a string input, parsing and validating.

methods.name: sortValues
methods.description: Sets the array of values used for cursor-based pagination, representing the last sorted item.

methods.name: dittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders object, including authorization and correlation info.

methods.name: thingsAskTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration for querying the things shard region.

methods.name: searchAskTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for asking the search actor.

methods.name: lastThingId
methods.description: Stores the ID of the last thing to support resuming search from a specific point.

methods.name: sortOptionAsString
methods.description: Converts a SortOption object into its string representation suitable for queries.

methods.name: getSortFields
methods.description: Extracts the property paths from a SortOption to create a JsonFieldSelector representing sort fields.

methods.name: getEffectiveSortOption
methods.description: Returns a SortOption based on input string, defaulting if null/empty, and appends ID field if missing.

methods.name: appendIdField
methods.description: Ensures that the sort option includes an ID property, appending it if absent.

methods.name: findUniqueSortOption
methods.description: Parses options string to find a single sort option, throwing exceptions if invalid or multiple are found.

methods.name: constructStreamThings
methods.description: Creates a StreamThings object representing the search query parameters.

methods.name: validateFilter
methods.description: Validates the filter string by parsing it with RqlPredicateParser, throws if invalid.

methods.name: validateSortOption
methods.description: Validates the sort option against field expressions; throws if invalid.

methods.name: checkForUnsupportedOptions
methods.description: Checks list of options for unsupported types, throws an exception if any are not supported.
